hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-griffin-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Each site includes water, electricity', 'Campsites 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 have sewer connections') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 33 bookable units Electric Hookup 20/30/50 and Water Hookup; 5 list Sewer Hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 40 campsites, seven pull-through; sites 8-14 have sewer; sites 26, 39 and 40 are glamping log cabins booked through the concessioner. Reserve Florida's per-site limits run 22 to 40 ft (a dozen sites under 30). The park sits directly off US 441, so the park page warns of some highway noise.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-griffin-state-park/experiences-amenities ('The park's 40 campsites, including seven pull-through sites', 'Maximum RV length is 40 feet', 'Campsites 26, 39 and 40 are Glamping Log Cabins', 'our park is located directly off U.S. Highway 441, so some highway noise is inevitable') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 97 (VehicleLength 22-40, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-griffin-state-park/experiences-amenities ('A dump station is available. Showers, restrooms and laundry facilities in the center of the campground are accessible'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-griffin-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 40 sites (7 pull-through) to 40 ft, 50-amp electric and water at every site, sewer at sites 8-14, showers/laundry/dump, reservable 11 months ahead. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $18 + utility). fcfs, season and stay limits left inherited/unstated. Note unchanged.
